title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.29635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of "diversity in unity" into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. translated_title: 多元一体、理论落地：面向中国少数民族语言的分层多任务基准
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）发展迅速，但其在统一国家框架内针对语言和文化多样的少数民族语言的表现仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了CMiLBench，这是一套分层多任务基准集合，旨在将“多元一体”的理论概念转化为对三种代表性中国少数民族语言——藏语、蒙古语和维吾尔语——的实用性评估。CMiLBench包含24,663个实例，涵盖5个难度级别和17个任务，横跨基础能力、文化特异性和安全对齐三大维度。我们采用现有数据集适配、少数民族知识构建以及高资源基准翻译的方法来构建CMiLBench。我们使用一个集成自动指标与LLM-as-a-Judge评分的混合框架，评估了14个最先进的商业和开源大语言模型。对比实验结果揭示了模型理论能力与实际应用之间的差距。
tldr: 该论文提出CMiLBench——首个面向藏语、蒙古语和维吾尔语三种中国少数民族语言的分层多任务评估基准，涵盖5个难度级别17个任务共24,663个实例，通过评估14个大语言模型揭示了其在少数民族语言上理论能力与实际表现之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CMiLBench, a hierarchical multitask benchmark for three representative Chinese minority languages (Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur), comprising 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks, whose evaluation of 14 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals the gap between theoretical capability and practical performance on minority languages.
